events.title: Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery  -  Autumn Exhibition
events.summary: The Peninsula's most serious public art institution, running a rotating autumn exhibition calendar that's quietly one of the best regional programmes in Victoria.

events.title: Bass & Flinders Gin Masterclass
events.summary: Three hours at the still in Dromana. Learn how gin actually gets made, blend your own botanicals, and walk out with a 500ml bottle of your own recipe.
events.accessibilityNotes: Distillery door wheelchair accessible; rooftop access, check with venue

events.title: Foxeys Hangout Vegetable Feast (Morning Sun Vineyard)
events.summary: Chef Bernard McCarthy's all-vegetable, multi-course feast at Morning Sun Vineyard in Main Ridge, matched to Foxeys wines. $85 a head, shared table, outdoors at a working vineyard.
events.streetAddress: 795 White Hill Road (Foxeys); Morning Sun Vineyard Main Ridge
events.accessibilityNotes: Outdoor vineyard terrain; not wheelchair accessible

events.title: Peninsula Hot Springs Daily Studio Yoga
events.summary: Daily 45-minute studio yoga at Peninsula Hot Springs (16+), a $20 add-on to a bathing session. Book early-morning or evening slots to avoid the crowd.
events.accessibilityNotes: Wellness Studio accessible; check with venue for specific needs

events.title: Peninsula Hot Springs Yoga (Complimentary)
events.summary: Free 25-minute outdoor yoga by the amphitheatre pools, included with bathing admission. Daily at 9:15am, all ages, no booking.
events.accessibilityNotes: Outdoor poolside, check with venue for mobility access to amphitheatre

events.title: Peninsula Hot Springs, Sound Healing Sessions
events.summary: Monthly sound healing immersion at Peninsula Hot Springs through autumn and winter. Thermal bathing paired with a guided sound session. Adults, bookings essential.
events.accessibilityNotes: Accessible thermal pools; check specific needs with venue

events.title: Polperro Cellar Table, Private Dining Experience
events.summary: Polperro's private dining room below the winery. Six to eight guests, five courses, the latest Polperro and Even Keel cuvees poured by the people who made them.
events.accessibilityNotes: Private room accessible, check with venue for specific needs

events.title: Pt. Leo Estate Sculpture Park
events.summary: Australia's largest privately owned outdoor sculpture park: 16.5 acres, 60+ contemporary works, two walking loops, all set inside a working winery. Open daily 11am to 5pm.
events.accessibilityNotes: Paved and gravel paths, mostly accessible; check with venue for specific needs

events.title: Restore & Pamper Retreat at Polperro Farmhouse
events.summary: 3-day, 2-night wellness retreat at Polperro Farmhouse in Red Hill. Yoga, massage at PHS or Endota, optional juice cleanse, set on a biodynamic vineyard. Booked direct via Polperro or Hut Yoga.
events.bookingRequired: Yes, contact Polperro or Hut Yoga
events.accessibilityNotes: Farmhouse accommodation accessible, check with venue

events.title: Sound Circle: Full Moon Sound Journey at Peninsula Hot Springs
events.summary: Monthly full-moon sound journey in the PHS Wellness Studio followed by an afternoon in the hot springs. $150 all-inclusive, sound bath plus tea plus bathing from midday. Hosted by Lucy Ennis (Sound Circle).
events.accessibilityNotes: Wellness Studio accessible; check with venue for specific mobility needs

events.title: Ten Minutes by Tractor, Terroir Masterclass
events.summary: One hour in TMBT's private tasting room. Eight wines (two limited-release, six current), the three single-vineyard sites side-by-side, and the long answer to why Pinot from Main Ridge tastes the way it does.
events.venueName: Ten Minutes by Tractor Cellar Door
events.accessibilityNotes: Cellar door fully accessible (wheelchair; stroller; transport accessible)

events.title: Peninsula Hot Springs Sunday Sessions
events.summary: Live music every Sunday afternoon from the amphitheatre pool stage at Peninsula Hot Springs. Weekly lineup of named artists. Not a standalone ticketed concert – included with afternoon bathing session. Runs May–June 2026.
events.accessibilityNotes: Accessible thermal pools available; check specific accessibility needs with venue

events.title: Rocky Road Festival Tasting Sessions
events.summary: Every Sunday in May at Mornington Peninsula Chocolaterie (Flinders): sample 8 Rocky Road flavours, a Rocky Road hot chocolate and ice cream, then build your own to take home. $28pp, 11am / 12pm / 1:30pm sessions.
events.accessibilityNotes: Ground floor accessible; check site for wheelchair access

events.title: Mornington Wednesday Market (Main Street Market)
events.summary: Victoria's longest-running street market – operating over 40 years every Wednesday on Main Street Mornington. 120+ stalls of handmade crafts, home-baked treats, home-grown plants and produce. Rain, hail or shine (high-wind policy applies). Vibrant weekly community gathering.
events.accessibilityNotes: Street market; footpaths; generally accessible; some uneven sections

events.title: Hastings Thursday Street Market
events.summary: Weekly outdoor street market on High Street Hastings every Thursday. 40+ stalls featuring homemade, homegrown and craft goods. Fresh produce, handmade goods, plants. Local food options available on the street.
events.accessibilityNotes: Street market; footpaths

events.title: Peninsula Hot Springs – Bathe-in Cinema (Thursdays)
events.summary: Watch a film from the amphitheatre thermal pool every Thursday night through autumn and winter. Bathing ticket required, lineup posted weekly.
events.accessibilityNotes: Accessible thermal pools available; check specific needs with venue

events.title: Crib Point Community Market
events.summary: Community market at Crib Point every second Saturday of the month. Spirit of community support and inclusion; promotes locally made handcrafted products and local produce.
events.accessibilityNotes: Community hall grounds

events.title: Heart of the Community Market (Rosebud)
events.summary: Community market at Rosebud on the second Saturday of the month. Approximately 160 stalls with craft, handmade and new products, fresh produce and plants. No used goods policy. Located near Rosebud foreshore.
events.accessibilityNotes: Foreshore/school grounds; generally accessible

events.title: Wild Mushroom Forage & Lunch with The Kitchen
events.summary: Guided autumn mushroom forage through the Red Hill and Main Ridge forests with an experienced guide, finished with a forest cook-up: butter, herbs, warm pan, good bread. Max 15 people.
events.bookingRequired: Yes, strictly limited to 15 per session
events.accessibilityNotes: Walking on forest terrain; not wheelchair accessible

events.title: Mornington Racecourse Market, May 2026
events.summary: Cancelled: the Mornington Racecourse Market scheduled for Sunday 10 May 2026 will not go ahead due to a race day at the racecourse.
events.accessibilityNotes: Flat racecourse areas; mainly accessible

events.title: Shoreham Community Market
events.summary: Locally run monthly market beside Shoreham Tennis Club: arts, crafts, music, food, kids' activities, yoga, dogs welcome. Third Sunday September to May.
events.accessibilityNotes: Near tennis club; grassed area; uneven ground

events.title: Soul Night Market – Sorrento Beach
events.summary: Evening street-food and makers market on the Sorrento foreshore: local stalls, food trucks, music, monthly across the warmer months.
events.accessibilityNotes: Beach foreshore; uneven sand surface; limited accessibility

events.title: Tootgarook Primary School Market
events.summary: Fourth-Saturday-of-the-month fundraiser market run by Tootgarook Primary, 250 stalls of everything from produce to second-hand. Proceeds back into the school.
events.accessibilityNotes: School grounds; generally accessible

events.title: Red Hill Truffles: Winter Truffle Hunt Season
events.summary: Guided winter truffle hunts at the Peninsula's first truffle producer, bundled with a meal at Red Hill Estate Restaurant, The Epicurean or pizza on the farm. From $189pp, late May to August for Périgord black, August to September for Bianchetto.
events.accessibilityNotes: Farm terrain; not wheelchair accessible

events.title: Flinders Truffles: Winter Truffle Hunt Season
events.summary: Guided Périgord black truffle hunts on the Flinders farm through winter (June to August), with truffle soup and a toastie by the fire. Farmgate days run without booking.
events.accessibilityNotes: Farm terrain, not wheelchair accessible

events.title: Red Hill Market  -  First Saturday, Every Month
events.summary: Victoria's largest artisan craft market. 200+ stalls, the whole ridge in one place, and a morning that pulls the entire Peninsula into orbit.

events.title: Soul Night Market – Mornington
events.summary: Evening street-food and makers market at the Peninsula Community Theatre precinct: local food vendors, artisan makers, live music, runs from 5pm.
events.accessibilityNotes: Theatre carpark/grounds; paved; generally accessible

events.title: Ninch Nabs: Samples & Seconds Makers Market
events.summary: One-day samples and seconds makers market at The Village Church Mount Eliza: local artists and small businesses moving handmade goods at accessible prices.
events.accessibilityNotes: Church venue; generally accessible

events.title: Mornington Racecourse Market
events.summary: Monthly craft market at Mornington Racecourse. 300+ stalls of hand-made, home-made and Australian-designed goods. Street food vendors, live music, animal farm and face painting for kids. Parking $5. Dogs not permitted (service dogs exempt).
events.accessibilityNotes: Lower members car park and racecourse; gravel/bitumen/grass; undulating; use caution with prams

events.title: Mornington Racecourse Monthly Market, June 2026
events.summary: Monthly market at Mornington Racecourse featuring handmade crafts, fashion, fresh produce, art, and artisan goods. Runs second Sunday of the month year-round. June 2026 edition noted on Shire markets page.
events.accessibilityNotes: Some flat racecourse areas; check for pram access to stall layout

events.title: Boneo Community Market
events.summary: Peninsula's longest-running volunteer-run community market. Third Saturday, year-round, all weather. Make it, grow it, bake it: real homemade and homegrown.
events.accessibilityNotes: Grassed reserve; prams accessible

events.title: Emu Plains Market, Balnarring
events.summary: Monthly artisan market at Emu Plains Reserve (Coolart Road, Balnarring). Showcases craft, design, vintage, music, and food. Family and community favourite under stringybark gums.
events.accessibilityNotes: Flat reserve ground; mostly accessible

events.title: Pearcedale Community Market
events.summary: Monthly third-Saturday community market under the eucalypts at Pearcedale: fresh bread, honey, jam, craft, plants, coffee. Dogs on lead welcome.
events.accessibilityNotes: Grassed reserve; picnic area; generally accessible

events.title: Sorrento Solstice Festival 2026
events.summary: Free winter solstice weekend on the Sorrento Foreshore. Two music stages, fire performers, a 6-metre burning effigy on the bay at 6:30pm Saturday, lanterns, food trucks, sunrise swim Sunday.
events.accessibilityNotes: Flat foreshore paths; some fire performance areas may be restricted

events.title: Sorrento Solstice Festival (Fire Night)
events.summary: The Saturday night centrepiece of Sorrento Solstice: the 6-metre 'Bernie' effigy burns on the bay at 6:30pm, with fire performers, lantern path, music stages, food trucks, silent disco. Free ticketed, 2pm to 9pm.
events.accessibilityNotes: Flat foreshore access; pram-friendly; limited mobility info, check with organiser

events.title: Mt Eliza Farmers Market
events.summary: The only VFMA-accredited farmers market on the Mornington Peninsula. Only genuine farmers and specialty makers. Monthly on the 4th Sunday. Produce includes Flinders Sourdough, Mumma Made jams, Red Hill Apples, Blue Bay cheese. VFMA accreditation guarantees farm-gate authenticity.
events.streetAddress: Corner Mt Eliza Way and Canadian Bay Road
events.accessibilityNotes: Village precinct; generally accessible; footpath stalls

events.title: Dromana Community Market
events.summary: Community market at Dromana Park on the last Saturday of every month. Mix of produce, craft, plants and local makers.
events.accessibilityNotes: Parkland; generally accessible

events.title: Winter Camp 2026, The Ranch
events.summary: Three-day residential winter camp at The Ranch Mornington Peninsula for ages 8+: mountainboarding, giant swing, flying fox, horse riding, bush cooking, night hike. $675 per person.
events.accessibilityNotes: Rural camp setting; some activities require physical ability; check with operator for specific accessibility

events.title: Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery, School Holiday Workshops
events.summary: Free and low-cost school holiday art workshops at MPRG: hands-on, artist-led, tied to current exhibitions. Kids 8+, teens and families. Bookings essential.
events.accessibilityNotes: Fully accessible gallery; wheelchair friendly; air conditioned

events.title: Youth Services School Holiday Program
events.summary: Free school holiday drop-in program for 10 to 17 year olds across four Youth Hubs: free wifi, games, art, food, and a weekly excursion. Operoo registration required, no booking for centre days.
events.venueName: Multiple Youth Hubs: Shed 11 (Hastings); The Corner (Mornington); Y Lounge (Rosebud); Somerville Rec Centre
events.streetAddress: Various: 11 Marine Parade Hastings; 91 Wilsons Road Mornington; 1 Nepean Plaza Rosebud; 14 Edward St Somerville
events.accessibilityNotes: Youth Hubs are accessible indoor spaces

events.title: Mornington Tourist Railway, School Holiday Special Runs
events.summary: Heritage steam and diesel rides on selected Sundays and through school holiday breaks. 5km between Moorooduc and Mornington, vintage carriages, simple and good.
events.accessibilityNotes: Platform access; some steps into carriages; check accessibility with operator

events.title: Soil & Cellar: Flinders Truffles x Polperro Winery
events.summary: Afternoon truffle hunt at Flinders Truffles, then a truffle-matched dinner at Polperro Winery with Sam Coverdale's wines. One ticket, one winter day.
events.accessibilityNotes: Truffle hunt on farm terrain, not wheelchair accessible; dinner venue, check with Polperro

events.title: Stonier Fire & Wine Winter Lunch
events.summary: Stonier's annual winter party. Food cooked over coals, new release Stonier wines, fires lit, live music, masterclasses and tours through the day. Sells out fast.
events.accessibilityNotes: Check with venue for access needs

events.title: Red Hill Brewery Secret Stash Weekend
events.summary: Head Brewer David Golding pulls cellar-aged and rare beers (Imperial Stout, Pancho Mole, Christmas Ale, Temptation, Mulled Mead) for guided vertical tastings. Club members get first dibs.
events.accessibilityNotes: Accessible parking; limited mobility path on sloped terrain; contact venue

events.title: Hill & Ridge Community Market, September 2026 (Restart)
events.summary: First market of the 2026–2027 season restart at Red Hill Recreation Reserve. Monthly artisan market celebrating local food, wine, produce, crafts and community. Fresh local products; food stalls; winemaker presence and artisan wares.
events.accessibilityNotes: Mostly flat; accessible parking

events.title: National Works on Paper 2026 (NWOP)
events.summary: MPRG's biennial $20,000 acquisitive survey of contemporary Australian work on paper: prints, drawings, collage, mixed media. Free, Tue to Sun 11am to 4pm.
events.accessibilityNotes: Fully accessible indoor gallery

events.title: Emu Plains Market
events.summary: Monthly artisan market at Emu Plains Reserve Balnarring. For lovers of craft, design, vintage, music and food. Seasonal schedule October–April (day market 9am–2pm) plus June and August dates. Site of the Womin Djeka cultural festival. Volunteer-run community hub.
events.accessibilityNotes: Grassed reserve; generally accessible; uneven ground in places

events.title: Main Street Mornington Festival 2026
events.summary: Annual free street festival on Mornington's Main Street: 7 stages, live music, local wine and craft beer, food stalls, artisan crafts, kids' activities, roving performers, 11am to 5pm on the third Sunday of October. 2026 contingent on sponsorship after 2025 was cancelled.
events.accessibilityNotes: Street event: flat Main Street terrain; pram-friendly; contact organiser for accessibility details

events.title: The Bloody Long Walk – Mornington Peninsula 2026
events.summary: 35km charity walk from Point Nepean Quarantine Station to Martha Cove Marina for the Mito Foundation. Walk, jog or run. Limited spots.
events.venueName: Point Nepean National Park (Quarantine Station start)
events.accessibilityNotes: Natural coastal terrain – not accessible for mobility impairments

events.title: Mornington Tourist Railway, Santa Specials
events.summary: Heritage steam train rides with Santa on selected December Sundays. Letters to the North Pole, carols at Moorooduc Station, the full Christmas treatment. Booking essential.
events.accessibilityNotes: Platform access; covered carriages

events.title: Mornington Christmas Festival & Main Street Christmas Parade
events.summary: Annual Mornington Christmas Parade at 1pm on Main Street (brass band, dancers, elves, Mr & Mrs Claus), Santa meet-and-greet 1:30 to 4pm same day, Santa on Main Street 4 to 7pm across 21 to 23 December. Free, 2026 dates pattern-based pending council confirmation.
events.accessibilityNotes: Main street; closed to traffic; accessible

events.title: Peninsula Summer Music Festival 2027
events.summary: Ten-day classical and contemporary festival across Peninsula wineries, churches and outdoor venues, 2 to 11 January 2027. Program TBC. 2026 featured baroque opera, The Bamboos, Karin Schaupp, Ensemble Offspring.
events.venueName: Multiple Peninsula venues: Flinders Civic Hall; Montalto; Port Phillip Estate; Peninsula Hot Springs; Main Ridge Estate; St John's Anglican Church Flinders
events.suburb: Flinders / Main Ridge / Rye / Red Hill
events.streetAddress: 56 Cook Street (Flinders Civic Hall); Merricks North (Montalto); 263 Red Hill Road (Port Phillip Estate)
events.accessibilityNotes: Varies by venue; confirm specific accessibility with festival team

events.title: Peninsula Summer Music Festival 2027, Save the Date
events.summary: Peninsula Summer Music Festival returns 2 to 11 January 2027. Program and tickets TBC. 2026 edition spanned 18 events at wineries, churches and outdoor venues.
events.accessibilityNotes: Venues vary, some outdoor, some historic churches; PSMF accommodates accessibility needs on request
